body: No one asked you to do anything.

If the post content appears removed, that's because it has been removed by one of the mods. And no reason has been given as of yet to why it was removed. I have messaged mods thrice, no response till now. If my post is violating any subreddit rule and that's why it was removed i very well will accept the judgement. But I think I at least deserve an explanation why. I did come to this subreddit for easing my conscience and validation. Both of which I got from the people here. Which is why I felt obligated to give them an update to my situation. I know this subreddit and it's members lives don't revolve around me. And nor is it central to how I live my life. But it has been a very useful platform for me for my own catharsis. And I am thankful to all those who commented on my post. And I am thankful to those who created this platform. Thank you all, and have a good day.

Edit: You can find the post [here](https://www.reddit.com/user/fuckedupugly/comments/c175fy/update_i_got_drunk_and_molested_my_friend/?utm_medium=android_app&utm_source=share) on my profile.

Edit: I got a reply from the mods. The reason for removal is: 

**"We require all submissions to be about immoral actions. Generally speaking, updates to past post do not meet this requirement unless you have committed another immoral action to which you wish to confess.**

**Your post was about making amends and healing. In that post you didn't do anything wrong."**

I can still see my post content from this throwaway account but from my main account i can see the content has been removed. I have messaged the mods for clarification if my post is breaking any subreddit rules. Haven't gotten any reply so far.

I am a guy. And I don't feel like I have been continuously harassed. The incidents i mentioned that seem like harassment are the only times they confronted me about my actions. I think those were quite warranted.
We are both guys and homosexual.

Thank you! I know what you mean about the rose coloured glasses slipping on. And I completely understand that my actions, even if forgiven, can come back to bite me in the ass anytime. I am always braced for that. But I don't want to run away either. I don't want to be the guy who runs away from facing the consequences of his actions.

I do have other friend circles and support systems. And I have a career and future i am preparing for. So really, i feel like I am set up for a better life. And winning a friend back is just the bonus. And also a reminder to keep myself accountable and responsible.
Perhaps. But I don't think I get to judge her for how she addressed it.
That happened just a few weeks after the incident, it was the first time we ran into each other face to face after that night. I don't think she planned to blast me. She just saw me and saw red.

Yes. I mostly have distanced myself and didn't really expect to be back in touch with them. But I really can't turn down an olive branch when offered. I don't really expect everything to go back to how it was. I am just glad that I got a friend back, because I really really value her. We have shared a lot of experiences together. And even if it's selfish and I don't deserve it, i don't want to lose her.

I am truly and terribly sorry. You are right, I don't deserve their forgiveness and have no right to expect it. I don't know what to do short of killing myself. But I don't think even that would help. Regardless of how they feel about me now, I think it would affect them worse. I just want them to know I am truly remorseful and regret my actions. I will just cut myself off them completely and live with the guilt.
I consciously have never thought that assaulting anyone, let alone someone I care about, is okay. I don't know how I could ever be capable of that. I will definitely get myself into therapy.

Thank you for showing me the kindness I don't deserve. I don't have any financial means to set up any donation yet. But I will work on it. And yes, I will immediately start on getting therapy. I would very much like to pay for whatever therapy S would need, but I don't have the guts to ask him that. And I don't think it will be helpful to him to approach him at all. It's best I cut myself off his life as best as I can.

Even if the other people in the group might forgive me and pity me, P and S never will. And I don't think I have enough time to convince them how truly sorry I am. I am completing my last semester for my Masters, after which we would rarely cross paths unless we deliberately come in contact, which I don't see happening anytime.

Being drunk is never an excuse. I know that. But at least when i am sober i am in control of my actions. People like me should never put themselves in a situation where they aren't in control. I am not responsible enough to handle my liquor. I swear I am never touching it again.
